case.summary: Case HHG-008 was opened on 2016-12-20 following customer C13171's report of an unauthorized $55.68 online purchase, transaction 3558054, on card C13171-K2. The investigation agent determined this was card-not-present fraud, closing the case with a fraud probability of 0.95 and an exposure of $166.97 across three transactions. The customer confirmed they did not make the purchase and still holds the card. Graph evidence showed the transaction was an online purchase from a device profile previously seen on this card, with a classifier score of 0.97. The card was blocked and a new case created, consistent with policy R2 due to customer denial and the exposure amount.
